name: Reduce browser MCP context with Direct Tools and discovery

description: Baseline harness failed before reaching MCP because the helper computed the repository root as its parent.

asi.hypothesis: Baseline harness should read actual MCP tool schemas for both exposure paths.
asi.rollback_reason: The measurement helper resolved packageRoot one directory above the repository and could not open mcp.json; no product files were changed.
asi.next_action_hint: Correct the root path and rerun the baseline.

description: Baseline: measured live MCP schemas for native fallback and package adapter exposure.

asi.hypothesis: Native fallback currently sends all registered tool schemas directly, while adapter sends only 16 direct schemas.
asi.finding: Native context is 61,213 schema bytes across 84 tools; adapter context is 10,842 bytes across 16 direct tools. Because the fallback uses hidden as server default and overrides all tools direct, no tools remain available through codemode discovery.
asi.next_action_hint: Align native fallback exposure with adapter: use codemode as default and mark the existing common allowlist direct.

description: Match native fallback to the adapter: 16 frequent tools direct, remaining MCP tools codemode-discoverable.

asi.hypothesis: Aligning native fallback with adapter's existing 16-tool direct allowlist while setting the default exposure to codemode should cut initial schema bytes and retain all advanced tools for discovery.
asi.finding: Native direct schemas now exactly match the adapter at 10,842 bytes (16 tools), down 82.3% from the measured pre-change native baseline of 61,213 bytes (84 tools). All 68 other registered tools remain available in the MCP server and are codemode-discoverable; full checks pass.
asi.next_action_hint: Review whether the existing 16 direct tools cover everyday navigation, inspection, and interaction before trying any further reduction.

name: Reduce initial MCP context with deferred browser discovery

description: Baseline for actual initial context: native direct declarations plus Pi's generated codemode catalog.

asi.hypothesis: The context proxy should include Pi's actual discovery route definition in addition to direct MCP schemas.
asi.finding: With the aligned native policy still set to codemode, the 16 direct schemas cost 10,842 bytes and the generated codemode entry/catalog costs 32,105 bytes; measured initial context is 42,947 bytes. Tool Discovery using deferred exposure should replace that catalog with the smaller tool_search entry.
asi.next_action_hint: Set adapter and native fallback defaults to deferred while keeping the 16 direct tools unchanged.

description: Switch both registration paths to deferred discovery; keep 16 frequent tools direct.

asi.hypothesis: Pi deferred exposure should keep advanced MCP schemas out of codemode's generated catalog and expose only the compact tool_search entry until a match is loaded.
asi.finding: Initial context fell from the codemode baseline 42,947 bytes to 11,457 bytes (73.3% reduction). Direct set stays 16 tools/10,842 bytes; tool_search route is 615 bytes; all 68 non-direct tools remain registered and discoverable. Adapter and native fallback measurements match exactly, and checks pass.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the direct allowlist unchanged; verify the generated codemode catalog is no longer activated by this server and inspect test coverage for on-demand search behavior.

description: Verification rerun: actual Tool Discovery loads deferred audit and storage tools; no primary metric change.

asi.hypothesis: Exercise Pi's actual BM25 tool_search implementation against the live MCP tool list to verify deferred tools are loadable.
asi.finding: Search loaded both `audit` from an accessibility/SEO query and `get_storage` from a cookies/storage query; each became active. Context metrics were deterministic and unchanged at 11,457 bytes. This is verification only, so no product optimization was made.
asi.rollback_reason: The verification improved coverage rather than the primary context metric, which remained unchanged; discard is correct under the primary-metric rule.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect the committed diff and check that the preserved pre-existing edits can be restored without conflicts.

description: Verification rerun: exact-name Tool Discovery finds all 68 deferred tools without changing context size.

asi.hypothesis: Test exact-name discovery for every deferred MCP operation to make sure lowering initial context did not make any advanced tool unreachable.
asi.finding: Pi's actual tool_search loaded the expected tool for exact-name queries across all 68 deferred operations; representative natural-language queries also load `audit` and `get_storage`. The primary context metric stayed at 11,457 bytes, so this is validation rather than a new optimization.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement was expected from adding verification; the deferred implementation remains at its last kept commit.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop changing exposure policy without real usage data; restore the pre-existing workspace edits and run the full checks against the combined tree.

name: Evaluate browser Tool Discovery recall on held-out tasks

description: Tool Discovery recall baseline did not start: isolated worktree could not resolve project dependencies.

asi.hypothesis: Evaluate natural-language retrieval on a disjoint set of deferred browser tasks before changing tool descriptions.
asi.rollback_reason: The isolated worktree had no node_modules, so its MCP server failed to import a runtime dependency and the benchmark timed out before collecting any metrics. No product code was changed.
asi.next_action_hint: Link the worktree to the existing dependency installation, confirm MCP startup, then rerun the same evaluation without changing its queries.

description: Baseline semantic discovery recall: holdout and calibration query sets, with context retained as a guardrail.

asi.hypothesis: A disjoint held-out set of user-intent phrases can reveal retrieval gaps that exact-name coverage misses, without changing the Direct Tool set or tuning against holdout.
asi.finding: Actual Pi BM25 search found 6/8 holdout tools (75%), 7/8 calibration tools (87.5%), and all 68 tools by exact name. Initial context stayed at 11,457 bytes. The suite is diagnostic; these synthetic rates are not usage estimates.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the holdout fixed; add per-query diagnostics in the harness and inspect calibration misses before considering any description change.

description: Diagnostics-only rerun identified one calibration miss and two held-out misses; no product changes.

asi.hypothesis: Print per-query discovery misses while keeping the calibration and holdout query sets unchanged.
asi.finding: The calibration miss is `screenshot_diff` for a saved-reference/visual-difference query. Holdout misses are `network_rules` for stopping API requests and `lighthouse` for page speed/performance; expected tools were outside the top 8. Holdout remains untouched for tuning. Primary metric stayed 75%, so this diagnostics-only run is discarded.
asi.rollback_reason: Instrumentation did not change retrieval or the primary metric.
asi.next_action_hint: Use the calibration-only screenshot_diff miss for a candidate description improvement; preserve holdout queries and require no holdout regression.

name: Improve browser Tool Discovery calibration recall

description: Baseline for calibration-led discovery improvement with fixed holdout guardrail.

asi.hypothesis: Use calibration recall as the optimization target and preserve the disjoint holdout as a no-regression guardrail.
asi.finding: Reinitialized baseline is calibration 7/8 (87.5%) and holdout 6/8 (75%); exact-name lookup remains 68/68 and context remains 11,457 bytes. The only calibration miss is the visual comparison query for screenshot_diff.
asi.next_action_hint: Clarify screenshot_diff's existing description with natural-language terms for comparing a current page against a saved reference, then rerun both fixed query splits.

description: Clarify screenshot_diff reference-comparison wording; calibration recall improves with holdout unchanged.

asi.hypothesis: Add user-facing reference/difference wording to the deferred screenshot_diff description based only on its calibration miss.
asi.finding: Calibration recall improved from 7/8 (87.5%) to 8/8 (100%). Holdout stayed at 6/8 (75%), so it did not regress; exact-name coverage remains 68/68 and initial context stays 11,457 bytes because the changed description remains deferred. npm run check and npm test passed.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep this narrowly scoped description change. Do not tune the two holdout misses without a new independent query set or real usage evidence.

description: One-shot generalization baseline for screenshot_diff wording; evaluation only, no query-specific tuning.

asi.hypothesis: The screenshot_diff description improvement should generalize beyond the calibration wording to varied requests about before/after screenshots and visual regression.
asi.finding: The one-shot generalization set scored 6/8 (75%). Calibration remains 8/8, the prior holdout remains 6/8, exact-name retrieval is 68/68, and initial context stays 11,457 bytes. The two new misses use phrases about identical appearance and preserving appearance; this set is evaluation-only and will not be tuned.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not change the description based on this score. Keep the result as a fixed observation and wait for real user queries or a separately preregistered evaluation before further search-metadata changes.
